column1: # p419 · 2026-10-24 · raw.githubusercontent.com serves `master` and `HEAD` as ALIASES for the default branch even when NO such ref exists.
# Authoritative ref set from `git ls-remote` (no alias can satisfy it). Negative controls: trunk, develop, NO_SUCH_REF_p419.
# A 404 body is 14 B, sha256_12 d5558cd419c8, the literal "404: Not Found".
# Consequence: p354's gate-grant-path contract ("a published grant path asserts a BRANCH and a FILE, and both must resolve") is UNFALSIFIABLE on this channel for refs `master` and `HEAD`. Gap 419-B.
# DECISIVE CONTROL, added after the first three: a repository whose default ref is NEITHER master NOR main.
# learningequality/kolibri defaults to `develop`. `master` aliases to DEVELOP (not to a branch called master, which does not exist); `main` returns 404.

# So the alias target is "the default branch, whatever it is named", and the alias NAMES are `master` and `HEAD` only. `main` never aliases - which is why p418's `main` -> 404 on aureus-erp/aureus was a TRUE negative.
